fonts.notes: Matches src/styles/tokens.css: --font-heading is Inter Tight, --font-body is Inter. Both ship via @fontsource-variable, no Google Fonts network call. A client can override the stack in tokens.css.

palette.notes: Monochrome base (black #0A0A0A brand, white/gray surfaces) with heritage green #35522C as the 10% accent layer: script accent words, icons, inline links, focus rings. Sage #9DBE8D on dark bands. All combos AA+ (green 8.8:1 on white).

emailCapture.doubleOptInNotes: Initial wiring uses Resend's Contacts API which is single opt-in. Switch to true once a custom confirmation-email flow is built (token-based magic link).

legal.businessAddress: 1588 S Robb Ct, Lakewood, CO (verify against GMB before launch)
legal.businessAddressNotes: PLACEHOLDER: service-area business with no public street address is common; record the customer's base city + zip and the counties served.
legal.contactEmailNotes: PLACEHOLDER: use a domain alias once the customer's domain is set up.
legal.cookieConsentNotes: Default is no analytics at all (cookieless-ready), so no consent banner / cookie policy ship. The cookie-policy page + GA4/GTM Consent Mode + banner are gated behind ENABLE_COOKIE_CONSENT in src/components/shared/CookieBanner.tsx. Flip it to true (and set the client's own GA/GTM ids in __root.tsx) only for a client that uses cookie-based analytics/ads; then legal.kind becomes full again.
legal.publishedNotes: PLACEHOLDER: legal pages ship as boilerplate. Have the customer review (ideally counsel-review), then flip published to true and set lastUpdated.

assets._notes: PLACEHOLDER: generate the customer's real brand assets (favicon, maskable icon, OG default + square, SVG logo + mark) from a 1024x1024 master via scripts/gen-icons.mjs, then update these statuses.
